skill1: Spy Lens: Minimum Effective Range ▲ 4.44%, stacks up to 10 time(s) and lasts for 5 sec.

caveats: ⚑ Minimum Effective Range ▲ (S1 Spy Lens 4.44%/stack, burst 55.56%) has NO StatKey in types.ts — the range-band/+30% full-range path is engine-automatic and takes no kit modifier. Both magnitudes are dropped; only the Spy Lens STACK COUNT is modeled (as the `spyLens` resource) because skill2's gate reads it. If the engine ever gains a range-band stat, these are the two lines to re-enact.

⚑ Spy Lens accrual assumes REFRESH-ON-STACK (each new stack refreshes the 5 s window). Under that reading the reload gap (141 f = 2.35 s) never breaks the chain, so 10 stacks are reached at ~10 full charges (~12-13 s) and then held for the rest of the fight. Under the alternative PER-STACK-INDEPENDENT-EXPIRY reading, only ~5 stacks are ever concurrent (5 s window ÷ ~1.0-1.2 s charge cycle) and skill2's max-stack block — Pierce + ATK ▲16% — would be COMPLETELY DEAD. This single semantic choice is the largest uncertainty in the override.

⚑ The `spyLens` resource never DECAYS (the engine has no time-decay on resource pools). Faithful only while the unit fires continuously; any firing gap > 5 s would drop real stacks below 10 while the sim keeps the gate open.

⚑ `hasPierce: true` is authored UNCONDITIONALLY, but the kit gates Pierce on max Spy Lens — it is really off for the first ~12 s (~7% of a 180 s fight). Pierce is the top-level CharacterSkills flag with no resource-gated form, so the ramp cannot be expressed; this over-credits her OWN benefit from her S2/burst Pierce Damage ▲ buffs early. `pierceModes` was not used (it keys on kit modes, not stacks).

The 'on targets within the effective range' activation clause on both S1a and S2a is treated as ALWAYS SATISFIED (single scope-lock boss, engine applies the range band automatically). If the sim ever models an out-of-band boss, both ally buffs would need a range gate.
SR full-charge modeling: every `shotFired` is treated as a Full Charge attack (chargeFrames 60). Correct only if the engine never fires uncharged SR shots.

`pierceDamagePct` is documented as 'parsed but inert in v1' except where a hit is Pierce-tagged — both ally Pierce buffs are kept regardless (schema-present stat, never a silent drop), and they DO become live for Ade herself once `hasPierce` is set.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Blind second read of Ade: Agent Bunny (ade-agent-bunny), SR/Iron/Supporter/Burst II, from kit prose + base stats only. Shape: a charge-cadence support — every full charge sprays a 5 s all-ally caster-ATK flat add (S1a, 15.2% of her ATK) and a 5 s all-ally Pierce Damage ▲18.36% (S2a), while self-stacking Spy Lens (S1b) toward a 10-stack threshold that unlocks continuous self Pierce + ATK ▲16% (S2b). Burst is a flat 10 s team Attack Damage ▲55.04% + Pierce Damage ▲10.13% on her own cast (Burst II, cd 20 s). Both Minimum Effective Range lines are unmodeled — no StatKey exists for range; only the stack COUNT survives, as the `spyLens` resource that S2b's `resourceGate` reads. Trigger identity: no line carries an 'entering Full Burst' clause, so the burst block is keyed `burstCast` (fires only on rotations SHE bursts), and both recurring conditionals are keyed `shotFired` (= one full charge for a charge weapon), NOT `interval`. No damage riders in the kit, so no noFb/noRange/core decisions arise.
